name: FAHCE Integrity Repair
description: FAHCE evaluates AI claims against supplied evidence in a pinned Azure confidential workload. Completed determinations carry independently verifiable Microsoft-signed proof of the scoped computation. Free MCP discovery; paid x402 REST determinations.
signing_scope: OCI artifact signing, Microsoft-signed runtime attestation, application receipts and payment settlement are separate evidence. OCI verification applies only to its exact artifact digest and trusted signing identity; it does not establish source/build provenance, deployment, external execution or permission to act. The downloaded receipt verifier checks runtime evidence, not OCI signatures. See /attestation for the dated, digest-scoped signing record and verifier limits.

quickstart.session: This endpoint issues no Mcp-Session-Id. Modern requests carry their metadata on every call; initialize alone does not supply it.
quickstart.tool_arguments: tools/list exposes a request wrapper. Submit properties.request alone to the advertised REST endpoint; idempotency_key maps to the optional REST Idempotency-Key header. MCP tools/call does not execute paid determinations.

cloudflare_origin.consumption_scope: Daily origin-intent ceilings use UTC dates and reserved amounts across states, not verified gateway charges: 100 USDC service-wide and 10 USDC per payment-context principal. The published credential threshold is 3 USDC, but wallet-only purchases have null credential_id and no credential-level daily aggregation. Each distinct payment authorization has a separate principal; these are not cumulative per-wallet limits or wallet allowances. Request-rate and concurrency guards are separate.

production_payment_verification.evidence: Successful HTTP 200 results and gateway PAYMENT-RESPONSE records, Cloudflare settled-payment activity and receiving-wallet receipts.
production_payment_verification.evidence_access: Public Base transaction links are provided for each operation. Gateway payment responses and seller receiving records support the corresponding FAHCE request references.

current_release_payment_verification.limits: Operator-published acceptance evidence for four controlled purchases on the identified tested Worker and pinned engine. A publication record, when present, identifies a later presentation-only release with unchanged protected machine source and runtime configuration; it does not claim new purchases. Tested source/build hashes and original transaction dates remain unchanged. Runtime version metadata is not a source-code signature. Transactions and receipt verification were checked when recorded, not on every page view. This is not a guarantee for every future request.

financial_records.longer_preservation: Applicable law, accounting obligations, unresolved reconciliation/disputes and legal holds

cloudflare_origin.workshop_definition: Workshop is FAHCE's authenticated owner workflow interface; payment for a machine determination grants no owner workflow authority.
cloudflare_origin.authentication: Wallet-only x402 purchase: verified gateway PAYMENT-CONTEXT creates a payment-bound machine principal for the exact operation and stored receipt. No prior key, invitation or account is required. Payment grants no human, Workshop, Admin or external execution authority.
cloudflare_origin.retry: Read HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED, use an x402 v2 client to authorize the selected requirement, then repeat the same REST URL, JSON and optional compatible Idempotency-Key (8 to 128 URL-safe characters); origin execution identity is server-owned with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Clients never create PAYMENT-CONTEXT.
cloudflare_origin.origin_validation: Ed25519 JWT from https://payments.cloudflare.com/certs; aud must equal the full canonical operation URL, including /api/v1/{operation}, not just the origin or the Everyone access policy. Timing, scheme and signed amount are required. Alternate hosts and query variants are rejected. A client-supplied header alone grants no authority.

headers.PAYMENT-REQUIRED: Gateway to client: base64 JSON requirements in HTTP 402
headers.PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: Client to gateway: base64 JSON x402 v2 payment authorization
headers.PAYMENT-CONTEXT: Gateway to origin: signed JWT; clients do not generate it
headers.PAYMENT-SETTLEMENT: Origin to gateway only: actual upto amount; omitted for exact and HTTP errors; removed before delivery to buyer
headers.PAYMENT-RESPONSE: Gateway to client: settlement receipt after successful settlement; never fabricated by the origin

cloudflare_origin.settlement: Exact: the origin omits PAYMENT-SETTLEMENT; the gateway settles the signed fixed amount and creates PAYMENT-RESPONSE after settlement. Bundle: zero for a nonbillable free-retry determination; 150000 for verified no-repair work; 390000 only for a required validated bounded repair plan. Held/invalid plans and unsupported processing return HTTP422 without an origin settlement instruction. A valid completed negative Verify returns its contracted determination and is billable even when verification.verified=false. HTTP 422 alone is not proof of no gateway charge; reconcile that individual purchase before paying again. A proposed plan never establishes external execution.
cloudflare_origin.receipts: Immutable origin receipts keep payment_receipt and settled_price_atomic_units null, including after delivery; later observations live in the separate append-only financial ledger. Customers retain the separate gateway PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement receipt. Origin delivery intent is not a charge receipt. The October 14 production purchases completed gateway settlement and seller receipt. Automated ledger reconciliation is a separate accounting workflow; an immutable pending origin receipt does not negate a separately confirmed settlement.
cloudflare_origin.repeated_delivery: One delivery intent per signed authorization. Retain FAHCE-Recovery-Token and read the exact saved receipt with Authorization: FAHCEReceipt <capability>, without payment. Repeated delivery returns a distinct 409 without releasing a recovery token or another result; use the original token, or request verified original-purchase recovery if the first response was lost. Do not authorize another payment to retry an unknown charge.
cloudflare_origin.mcp: Discovery is free. MCP tools/call does not execute commercial operations. Buy through corresponding REST URLs; no pilot key can bypass their rules, whether acceptance is on or off.
external_dependencies: Active gateway rules and valid payment authorization
Wallet balance and, for upto, Permit2 allowance and any required approval-transaction gas
Separate accounting review for unresolved individual purchases

tasks_scope: Descriptive service outcomes, not callable method names. Receipts accompany completed REST determinations; no standalone receipt-issuance tool exists. Use tools/list for callable discovery names and their REST mapping.

steps: Review the published policies and send FAHCE-Terms-Accepted with their publication hash on each purchase
POST diagnose with the original request; contradictory evidence should produce original_verified=false
POST repair only when a validated plan is eligible; a held plan returns a nonbillable error and is not executed
POST verify with revised candidate_output; retain the recovery credential and immutable receipt

acceptance.notice: Review these policies before payment; the authorized customer or its agent accepts this exact published version by sending this header on the purchase request.

services.name: Diagnose
services.description: Check an AI-generated answer against supplied evidence. Identify unsupported claims, contradictions, missing proof, and reported actions that the available records do not establish.
services.use_when: You need to understand what the supplied evidence establishes.

services.name: Repair
services.description: Evaluate an integrity problem and return a bounded, evidence-preserving correction plan when supported. Proposed corrections are not executed in the customer's systems.
services.use_when: An identified deficiency needs a scoped correction with prerequisites and protected evidence.
services.settlement_display: $0.15 for an eligible bounded plan; held/invalid plans are nonbillable errors, not proof of no gateway charge

services.name: Verify
services.description: Recheck a submitted or revised answer against supplied evidence. Return a scoped verification determination and cryptographically attested engine receipt without claiming independent external execution.
services.use_when: A claimed fix or completed action needs evidence-bound review.

services.name: Repair Bundle
services.description: Receive diagnosis, a bounded proposed repair when required, verification state, and a receipt in one paid response. Authorize up to $0.39; eligible outcomes may settle at $0, $0.15, or $0.39.
services.use_when: You need the connected diagnosis, proposed correction and current verification state in one determination.
services.settlement_display: $0.15 without repair required; $0.39 with repair required

supported_inputs.aggregate_limit: The entire UTF-8 encoded JSON body must fit within 524288 bytes (512 KiB), including all fields, labels, escaping and JSON overhead. Per-field maxima are independent ceilings; they cannot all be used at once. MCP discovery requests include JSON-RPC framing in this limit; this does not enable paid MCP execution.
supported_inputs.expected_output: Optional format/constraint and repair-target context for all operations, including Diagnose. Recognized directives (e.g. Return JSON) can affect diagnosis. Factual text is not compared for string equality or trusted as evidence; supply independent records.
supported_inputs.evidence: Up to 12 caller-supplied log, paste, document (text only) or description items; each up to 200000 characters, within the aggregate body ceiling
supported_inputs.provenance: Caller-supplied source labels and text are retained with hashes; labels do not authenticate authority.
unsupported: binary PDF/image interpretation through this API

error_boundary: FAHCE application errors use a JSON envelope. Upstream WAF, Access or transport rejection can occur before the application and return HTML or another non-JSON response, including when Accept is application/json. Machine clients must inspect HTTP status and Content-Type before decoding and must never interpret a security block as an integrity determination. Security protections remain enforced.
authentication: Paid commercial REST calls use wallet-only x402; gateway-verified PAYMENT-CONTEXT grants a machine-only principal. No pilot key or account setup. A pilot key alone never authorizes a commercial machine operation. Independently authenticated human and owner routes remain separate; cookie mutations require same-origin Origin.

transactions.payment_flow: request the operation; read the gateway's HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED; authorize payment with an x402 v2 client; retry the same bound request using PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. No pilot key, invitation or prior account is required. The verified payment creates a machine-only principal for this operation. Before authorizing payment, review the published policies and send FAHCE-Terms-Accepted with their legal_documents.publication_hash on the bound request. Retain the random FAHCE-Recovery-Token for free recovery. It authorizes only this purchase's retained output and is not a refund or execution credential. If the first response is lost before the token arrives, original-purchase evidence must be verified separately; do not buy again automatically. The origin verifies the gateway-signed PAYMENT-CONTEXT; PAYMENT-SETTLEMENT is an origin-to-gateway instruction for upto only. Exact responses omit that instruction. The gateway returns PAYMENT-RESPONSE after settlement. Origin delivery intents are not charge receipts. Paid determinations execute only through REST; MCP tools/call does not execute them.
transactions.idempotency: An authorization executes at most once. Repeating it returns a distinct 409; recover the saved result with the scoped credential. Optional keys bind unchanged input and a single authorization. Changed input or a new authorization conflicts with a reused key. Receipt recovery performs no determination.
transactions.payment_boundary: Payment authorizes service access; it does not establish claim correctness, external execution or permission to act.

boundaries.evidence_scope: Only the evidence supplied by the caller is reviewed; no independent web retrieval is performed.
boundaries.unknown_semantics: Unestablished claims remain UNVERIFIED or held; an unsupported operator cannot establish a clear result.
boundaries.repair: A proposed plan is not an executed repair. Verification reviews the separately submitted revised answer.
boundaries.receipt: New production machine and human engine runs carry Microsoft-signed hardware attestation bound to the exact processed input and result. The edge verifies the pinned workload and fresh challenge before delivery. Public verification material and instructions: /attestation. Attestation proves scoped engine computation, not source authenticity or external execution.

receipt_boundary: For a completed determination, response.request_id is the receipt_id UUID and equals receipt.case_id and receipt.run_id. Error-envelope request_id is an HTTP trace; use error.receipt_id when present. New production machine and human engine runs include Microsoft-signed hardware attestation binding the exact processed input and result, with encrypted edge-to-workload transport. Verify the full receipt using /attestation and /api/v1/attestation/trust. Each receipt binds input/evidence hashes, engine version and response hash. Supply prior-case context as evidence text; this contract does not automatically load a human case or prior repair. Immutable origin charge fields remain null. Retain the gateway PAYMENT-RESPONSE separately; completed production settlement is established separately by gateway and receiving-wallet records. Automated ledger reconciliation remains a separate accounting workflow.
